title: Authenticate to the read-only API
summary: Create a scoped token, call the version 3.0 status endpoint, and rotate the credential without logging secrets.

sections.title: Use a scoped token
paragraphs: The example uses a placeholder and never stores a credential in source control or browser storage.

warning.condition: A token is copied into a command history, URL, or repository file.
warning.consequence: The credential can be recovered by another user or automated scanner.
warning.avoidance: Load secrets from a protected environment and redact authorization headers from logs.
